name: Asuma Akito
source:
The grandson of the president of the company where Wataru works.
He is a student and will take the entrance exam this year.
Since his parents are rarely at home, he hires a housekeeper, and the job was introduced to Rumi through the president.
He is polite, calm, and a nice young man who smiles a lot for his age.
--He is polite and calm, and acts as if he were a young man.
